name: CAT Z Studio
author: Addicting Games
description:
CAT Z Studio is a music creating tool and game with a drag and drop mixing experience. It's built of 10 different game modes and focuses on a specific music style that contain upto 12 different
loops and beats. The game features equalisers and other settings to deliver the best possible gaming experience. When you are satisfied with your mix you can save it to enjoy it later.
